# 2 Chronicles 2 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 2 (18 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.1
- **EMET:** "And-he-said Solomon to-build a-house for-name-of YHWH and-a-house for-his-kingdom."
- **LOGOS:** "Now Solomon purposed to build a house for the name of the LORD and a house for his kingdom."
- **PNEUMA:** "Solomon decided to build a temple for the name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.3
- **EMET:** "And-he-sent Solomon to-Huram king-of Tyre saying as-that you-dealt with-David my-father and-you-sent to-him cedars to-build for-him a-house to-dwell i"
- **LOGOS:** "And Solomon sent word to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, "As you dealt with David my father and sent him cedars to build himself a house to dwell in —"
- **PNEUMA:** "Solomon sent this message to King Huram of Tyre: "Do for me what you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build his palace."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.8
- **EMET:** "And-send to-me trees-of cedar cypress and-algum from-the-Lebanon for I know that your-servants know to-cut trees-of the-Lebanon and-behold my-servants"
- **LOGOS:** "Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum timber from Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. And behold, my servants w"
- **PNEUMA:** "Also send me cedar, cypress, and algum logs from Lebanon. I know your workers are experienced at cutting Lebanese timber. My workers will join yours"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.9
- **EMET:** "and-to-prepare for-me trees for-abundance for the-house that I am-building is-great and-wonderful."
- **LOGOS:** "to prepare timber for me in abundance, for the house I am about to build will be great and wonderful."
- **PNEUMA:** "to produce lumber in large quantities, because the temple I'm building will be impressively large."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.13
- **EMET:** "And-now I-have-sent a-man wise having-understanding Huram my-master-craftsman"
- **LOGOS:** "Now I am sending a skilled man, endowed with understanding, Huram my master craftsman,"
- **PNEUMA:** "I am sending you Huram-abi, a master craftsman of great skill."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.18
- **EMET:** "And-he-made from-them seventy-thousand bearing-burdens and-eighty-thousand quarrying in-the-hill-country and-three-thousand and-six-hundreds overseers"
- **LOGOS:** "He assigned 70,000 of them to bear burdens, 80,000 to quarry in the hill country, and 3,600 as overseers to make the people work."
- **PNEUMA:** "He assigned 70,000 as laborers, 80,000 as stonecutters in the hills, and 3,600 as foremen to keep the people working."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

*— SOPHIA*
